# Semiotic

> React data visualization library with charts, network graphs, streaming data, and coordinated dashboards. Machine-readable schemas, executable examples, diagnostics, and an MCP server support generating, checking, and repairing chart code.

Install with `npm install semiotic`. Start the MCP server with `npx -y -p semiotic semiotic-mcp`.

- [Documentation catalog](https://semiotic.nteract.io/llms.txt) — published charts, features, and examples
- [Repository instructions](https://github.com/nteract/semiotic/blob/main/AGENTS.md) — development workflow and source map
- [System prompt](https://github.com/nteract/semiotic/blob/main/ai/system-prompt.md) — chart authoring and validation
- [Component schema](https://github.com/nteract/semiotic/blob/main/ai/schema.json) and [examples](https://github.com/nteract/semiotic/blob/main/ai/examples.md) — retrieve the selected chart's contract and usage
- [Source Task Packets](https://github.com/nteract/semiotic/blob/main/ai/task-packets/index.json) — development-build guidance and verification limits
- [Full AI reference](https://github.com/nteract/semiotic/blob/main/ai/reference.md) — detailed API guidance
- [README](https://github.com/nteract/semiotic/blob/main/README.md) and [changelog](https://github.com/nteract/semiotic/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) — installation and migration notes
